color.note: Semantic color-* tokens first; style components with these. The scales underneath are Radix Colors (MIT). Light is the default theme.

tokens.name: color-page
tokens.usage: Full-page background for docs, auth and marketing screens with no app shell.

tokens.name: color-shell
tokens.usage: App frame behind the sidebar and the main panel. The sidebar sits on it with no fill.

tokens.name: color-container
tokens.usage: Main content panel inset 8px into the shell, with radius-2xl and shadow-border. Default preview ground.

tokens.name: color-container-recessed
tokens.usage: A panel set slightly back inside a container.

tokens.name: color-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, menus, toasts, command palette. The lightest surface in dark mode.

tokens.name: color-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and drawers: black at 30% in light, 50% in dark.

tokens.name: color-card
tokens.usage: Tinted block grouping content on a container. It is a 2 to 4% tint, so text never relies on it for contrast.

tokens.name: color-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and tracks: segmented control track, code block background.

tokens.name: color-standout
tokens.usage: Inverted chip such as a tooltip. Dark in light mode, raised gray in dark mode.

tokens.name: color-component
tokens.usage: Default fill for tertiary buttons, badges, kbd, inline code, skeletons.

tokens.name: color-component-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for component.

tokens.name: color-component-active
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected fill for component. Switch track when off.

tokens.name: color-component-on-sunken
tokens.usage: Raised item inside a sunken track, such as the active segment.

tokens.name: color-component-on-inverted
tokens.usage: Fill on an inverted or standout surface, such as a kbd inside a tooltip or the primary button.

tokens.name: color-component-on-container-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet field fill on a container.

tokens.name: color-component-on-container-subtle-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of component-on-container-subtle.

tokens.name: color-component-on-container-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button, input, select and OTP cell fill.

tokens.name: color-component-on-container-strong-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for the secondary button.

tokens.name: color-transparent
tokens.usage: Resting fill of ghost buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: color-transparent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons, menu items and table rows.

tokens.name: color-transparent-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for ghost elements.

tokens.name: color-brand-solid
tokens.usage: Brand button, checked checkbox and radio, switch when on. At most one brand button per screen.

tokens.name: color-brand-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for brand-solid.

tokens.name: color-brand-solid-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for brand-solid.

tokens.name: color-brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Brand badge, selected row tint, info banner.

tokens.name: color-brand-subtle-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for brand-subtle.

tokens.name: color-brand-subtle-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for brand-subtle.

tokens.name: color-positive-solid
tokens.usage: Success dot and small indicators.

tokens.name: color-positive-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for positive-solid.

tokens.name: color-positive-solid-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for positive-solid.

tokens.name: color-positive-subtle
tokens.usage: Success badge and banner fill.

tokens.name: color-positive-subtle-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for positive-subtle.

tokens.name: color-positive-subtle-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for positive-subtle.

tokens.name: color-warning-solid
tokens.usage: Warning dot and small indicators.

tokens.name: color-warning-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for warning-solid.

tokens.name: color-warning-solid-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for warning-solid.

tokens.name: color-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Warning badge and banner fill.

tokens.name: color-warning-subtle-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for warning-subtle.

tokens.name: color-warning-subtle-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for warning-subtle.

tokens.name: color-danger-solid
tokens.usage: Destructive confirm button, error dot.

tokens.name: color-danger-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for danger-solid.

tokens.name: color-danger-solid-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for danger-solid.

tokens.name: color-danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Error badge, banner and the danger-subtle button.

tokens.name: color-danger-subtle-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for danger-subtle.

tokens.name: color-danger-subtle-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for danger-subtle.

tokens.name: color-inverted-solid
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the active tab bar: black in light, white in dark.

tokens.name: color-inverted-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for the primary button.

tokens.name: color-inverted-solid-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for the primary button.

tokens.name: color-disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled filled controls.

tokens.name: color-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on page, container, card and modal. About 16:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: color-secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels, supporting copy and idle icons on page, container, card, modal and component fills. 5.7:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: color-secondary-foreground-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque version of secondary-foreground for places where alpha would stack, such as text over images.

tokens.name: color-tertiary-foreground
tokens.usage: Meta text only on page, container and modal: timestamps, placeholders, hints, table headers, menu shortcuts. 3.3:1 light and 3.7:1 dark, below AA for body text, so never use it for content a user must read.

tokens.name: color-disabled-foreground
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Below 3:1 on purpose; WCAG exempts disabled controls.

tokens.name: color-brand-foreground
tokens.usage: Links and brand-tinted text on page, container and modal. 4.8:1 light, 7.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-positive-foreground
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on page, container and modal. 4.7:1 light, 7.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on page, container and modal. 4.5:1 light, 7.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-danger-foreground
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive links and the danger-subtle button label on page, container and modal. 5.0:1 light, 5.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-on-inverted-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverted-solid. About 19:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: color-on-standout-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Main text on standout, such as tooltip text. 15:1 or better.

tokens.name: color-on-standout-secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text on standout, such as a shortcut in a tooltip. 5.0:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: color-border-on-standout
tokens.usage: Hairline edge around standout surfaces so they hold their shape in dark mode.

tokens.name: color-on-brand-solid-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-solid. 3.3:1 in both themes: passes for icons and large text, below AA for 13px labels. Keep labels short, or use the primary button for important actions.

tokens.name: color-on-brand-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on brand-subtle. 4.3:1 light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-on-positive-solid-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on positive-solid. 3.1:1 light, 3.2:1 dark: icons and large text only.

tokens.name: color-on-positive-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on positive-subtle. 4.3:1 light, 8.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-on-warning-solid-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on warning-solid: near-black in both themes. 5.5:1 light, 6.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-on-warning-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on warning-subtle. 4.0:1 light, 8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-on-danger-solid-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on danger-solid. 3.8:1 light, 3.9:1 dark: passes for icons and large text, below AA for 13px labels.

tokens.name: color-on-danger-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on danger-subtle. 4.8:1 light, 8.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-border-default
tokens.usage: Dividers, table header rules, card and input edges.

tokens.name: color-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers inside cards, menus and table bodies.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised edges and the drawer grab handle.

tokens.name: color-border-strong-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque version of border-strong.

tokens.name: color-border-inverted
tokens.usage: Edge in the opposite tone.

tokens.name: color-border-control
tokens.usage: Unchecked checkbox and radio outlines. 3.3:1 light, 3.7:1 dark on container.

tokens.name: color-brand-border-default
tokens.usage: Selected card or brand-tinted outline.

tokens.name: color-brand-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet brand outline.

tokens.name: color-brand-border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every interactive element. 3.2:1 or better on every light surface, 4.9:1 or better in dark.

tokens.name: color-positive-border-default
tokens.usage: Success outline.

tokens.name: color-positive-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet success outline.

tokens.name: color-warning-border-default
tokens.usage: Warning outline.

tokens.name: color-warning-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet warning outline.

tokens.name: color-danger-border-default
tokens.usage: Error outline on inputs.

tokens.name: color-danger-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet error outline.
